title: Arrays of scalars at the document root never reconstruct
rationale: The commonest JSON shape in the world and it silently does not round-trip, for a structural reason invisible from the outside: analyzeStructure prefix loop is for (i = 1; i < parts.length; i++), so a one-segment key contributes no prefix and can never be flagged as an array, no matter what its value looks like.
catchesBugClass: Depth-dependent behaviour of the array heuristic. Catches any regression where root-level leaves are handled by a different path from nested leaves, and pins that the loss is on the reconstruct side.
cannotCatch: It cannot distinguish "a root array is not detected" from "a root array is detected but not parsed", because processArrays reaches the same else-branch either way. It also cannot cover the inverse hazard of a user string that genuinely is "[1,2,3]".

predicted.detail: Both arrays survive flattening intact and come back as those same Strings. The information is fully present in the flattened form; only the reconstructor discards it.
